# Tayseer Laz — Personal Portfolio

## About
Tayseer Laz is a Product Developer based in Beirut, Lebanon. He holds a Bachelor of Engineering in Computer & Communication Engineering from Rafik Hariri University, Lebanon. He specializes in end-to-end product development, UI/UX design, SaaS platforms, mobile applications, and AI integration. He has 2+ years of experience, has built 4+ products, and worked with 3+ companies.

## Projects

### Aligned Tech — Live Website (2025 — Present)
Role: Lead Designer & Developer at Aligned Tech
Designed and built the Aligned Tech corporate website end-to-end (live at https://www.aligned-tech.com). A Vite + React marketing site for a Lebanon-based technology consultancy delivering AI automation, cloud, WhatsApp business, cybersecurity, web/mobile development, and IT support. Built a custom blog CMS, implemented dynamic SEO per page (titles, descriptions, JSON-LD, sitemap), tuned Core Web Vitals (sub-1.5s LCP), authored page-specific GSAP motion design, and shipped through Vercel.
Tech: React, Vite, GSAP, Vercel, CSS Modules, Figma

### iEvents — All-in-One Event Platform (2024 — 2025)
Role: Product Developer at iEvents Qatar
All-in-one event platform serving the Qatar market — connecting attendees, organizers, and vendors. Designed UI/UX, architected the multi-role admin panel, integrated an on-site POS, embedded an AI assistant for attendees, and shipped iOS and Android apps to App Store and Google Play. Coordinated cross-functional teams across Qatar, Turkey, and Lebanon. Mentored interns and junior developers.
Tech: React Native, Firebase, Node.js, Figma, AI Integration

### Bsheel — Gamified Real-World Quests (2025)
Role: Founder & Product Developer
A gamified quest app where users complete real-world challenges, submit photo or video proof, earn XP, level up through a class progression (Scout → Warrior → Mage → Champion → Legend), and compete on a global leaderboard. AI generates quests across five categories. Includes an Instagram-style social feed, push notifications, badges, and a Flutter Web admin dashboard for moderation. Built as a Flutter monorepo with Supabase backend and Cloudflare R2 storage. Localized for English and Lebanese Arabizi.
Tech: Flutter, Supabase, Riverpod, GoRouter, Firebase, Cloudflare R2, Postgres

### OmniSign — AI Sign Language Translation (2024 — Present)
Role: Co-Founder & Product Contributor
AI-powered sign language platform co-founded by Tayseer Laz, featuring gesture recognition and real-time translation for accessibility. The platform aims to bridge communication gaps for the deaf and hard-of-hearing community. Built the first Lebanese Sign Language dataset. Structured workflows for AI gesture recognition pipeline. Designed user experience focused on accessibility and inclusivity.
Tech: Python, TensorFlow, React, Computer Vision
